params.caption: 🎮 Marathon adds a co-op PvE roguelite mode in December Bungie has released a gameplay trailer for Marathon's new co-op PvE roguelite mode and a fresh social space. Both arrive with the Symbiosis update on December 8, which also starts a beta for Team Deathmatch and comes with a free-play week. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 00:16 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer #Marathon #Bungie #GamingNews
